_comment: Explicit allowlist of Discord channel IDs the selena-project actively uses.
(after env-var default, openclaw.json guild channels, AGENT_DEFAULT_CHANNELS,
and ANNOUNCE_CHANNEL). Used by the service-manager watchdog's 30s cycle to
catch 404s proactively — see loose-end todo c700f895 (2026-06-06 mass-misroute).
- a Discord channel is deleted and recreated with a new ID (the watchdog
will surface the 404 within 5 min, but updating here lets the next probe
find the new ID by name only — see notes column).
- you add a new channel that selena-project should monitor.
Format: a list of {id, name, note} objects. `id` and `name` are required;
`note` is free-form (purpose, fallback ID, etc.). The function reads this
file and adds each id (deduped) to the channel-health probe list.

channels.name: #selena-project-important
channels.note: Escalation channel for blockers / questions / security

channels.name: #selena-memory
channels.note: Notable loose-end items from selena-memory-loose-ends cron

channels.name: #project-lunaris
channels.note: Project Lunaris main channel (renamed from #selena-lunar-project on 2026-06-12; the project was previously known as selena-project-2 / selena-project-lunarisis). Per Arcurus 2026-06-12: use 'project-lunaris' as the canonical user-facing name; legacy aliases (selena-project-lunarisis, selena-project-2) should not appear in user-facing labels.

channels.name: #openworld
channels.note: Adjacent project; selena-open-world-worker channel — ID was rotated 2026-06-06
